lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular 2D grid posterior to the gill slits along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, forming distinguishable grid-like nodes across the mid-section of the animal.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features on the upper flank characterized by a high-contrast transition from high-luminance upper edges to shadowed lower edges.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive mechanical trauma to the first dorsal fin resulting in a jagged, truncated silhouette with yellow-toned biological clusters along the trailing edge; large irregular notch/loss of tissue on the posterior margin of the upper caudal fin lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense aggregation of small commensal fish clustered around the pectoral fin and lower lateral regions.
